title: How India Turned Smartphone Imports Into a 165x Global Megafactory

scenes.voiceoverText: Ten years ago, three out of every four smartphones in India were imported.
scenes.captionMarkup: Ten years ago, three out of every four *smartphones* in India were *imported.*

scenes.voiceoverText: Today, 99.2% of phones sold in India are made right here. How? Stay with me, because one number in this video explains everything.
scenes.beatACaption: Today, *99.2%* of phones sold in India are *made right here.*
scenes.beatBCaption: How? Stay with me, because *one number* in this video explains *everything.*

scenes.voiceoverText: In 2014, India exported just 1,566 crore rupees of mobile phones — ranked a tiny number 153.
scenes.captionMarkup: In *2014,* India exported just *1,566 crore* rupees of mobile phones — ranked a tiny *#153.*

scenes.voiceoverText: And today? 2,60,000 crore rupees! That is 165 times more — now India's number one tech export!
scenes.captionMarkup: And *today?* *2,60,000 crore* rupees! That is *165 times* more — now India's *#1 tech export!*

scenes.voiceoverText: So how did it happen? India launched PLI in mission mode, jumping from 2 factories to over 300!
scenes.captionMarkup: So how did it happen? India launched *PLI* in *mission mode,* jumping from *2* factories to over *300!*

scenes.voiceoverText: And this is no basic assembly — precision enclosures, optics, and circuit boards built in Chennai, Bengaluru, and Noida.
scenes.captionMarkup: And this is no basic assembly — precision *enclosures, optics,* and *circuit boards* built in *Chennai, Bengaluru,* and *Noida.*

scenes.voiceoverText: Here is that locked number: India builds 10+ smartphones every single second — including 1 in 7 iPhones on Earth!
scenes.captionMarkup: Here is that *locked number:* India builds *10+ smartphones* every single *second* — including *1 in 7* iPhones on *Earth!*

scenes.voiceoverText: And the world is buying. Millions of Made-in-India phones now ship to the US, UK, Europe, UAE, and Japan.
scenes.captionMarkup: And the world is *buying.* Millions of *Made-in-India* phones now ship to the *US, UK, Europe, UAE,* and *Japan.*

scenes.voiceoverText: Now, the honest part. We still import most of the tiny silicon chips inside those phones.
scenes.captionMarkup: Now, the *honest* part. We still import most of the tiny *silicon chips* inside those phones.

scenes.voiceoverText: Which is why five semiconductor fabs worth 1.52 lakh crore are rising in Gujarat and Assam. A country that only assembles is a factory. A country that builds the chips is a superpower.
scenes.beatACaption: Which is why *five semiconductor fabs* worth *1.52 lakh crore* are rising in *Gujarat* and *Assam.*
scenes.beatBCaption: A country that only assembles is a *factory.* A country that builds the *chips* is a *superpower.*
